nodes.text:
China is facing a new virus outbreak with the Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) spreading rapidly, causing flu-like and COVID-19-like symptoms.

Mr. Xi Jinping is happy.
Because if all of common Chineses died; his party will get their organs, money, real estate and other things.
